name: tokut
description: Watch live local AI token burn and API-equivalent cost across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google logs.

interface.shortDescription: Live local AI token burn and cost dashboard.
interface.longDescription: Tokut watches local OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code, and Google Gemini CLI session logs to show live token burn, model and project breakdowns, subscription-covered theoretical cost, API/overage exposure, and provider/account filters. It is read-only and treats local logs as burn evidence, not invoices.
defaultPrompt: Use Tokut to start a live token burn dashboard.
Use Tokut to explain which project is burning the most tokens.
Use Tokut to check actual API/overage exposure versus subscription-covered burn.
